mineru-precision-extract 1.0.2

- Metadata improved: now explicitly declares the required environment variable (`MINERU_TOKEN`) and config file (`~/.mineru/config.yaml`).
- No changes to code or core functionality.

- Added metadata fields: homepage, source, author, and license to the skill manifest.
- No changes to code or CLI features—documentation and descriptive metadata improved only.

- Initial release of mineru-precision-extract.
- Offers high-precision document extraction with support for tables, formulas, and OCR.
- Supports multi-format output: Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, DOCX, JSON.
- Enables batch processing and web crawling for document and page extraction.
- Allows model selection (vlm/pipeline) for accuracy or zero-hallucination.
- Supports over 80 languages and a wide range of document formats.
